title: Nine evals for every operation
summary: prove now prints nine evals for every operation, the way the docs show it: answer shape, declared errors, machine path, events, who may call, steps, performance, coverage and explainability, each with its p50, p95 and budget. Coverage became each operation's own eval: it fails an operation no journey calls, a move no journey makes, an outcome never reached or a declared error never given. One line then counts the whole run: three moves, three outcomes, both declared refusals, and four of seven runtime refusals. Every planted fixture still fails its own eval.
proves: architect prove on acme prints 9 evals ✔ for get, grant, revoke, spend and create, and the coverage line; the gate test passes with every planted fixture failing.

captions.01-prove-acme-nine-evals: architect prove on acme: six journeys, then each operation's nine evals and its timing, the coverage line, prove ✔.
captions.02-prove-gate-and-planted: prove's tests: acme passes, scaffolded handlers fail, and every planted fixture fails its own eval, coverage now on organization.rename itself.
captions.03-all-checks-green: Lint, typecheck and test across every project, cache off.
